name: Eyelet
author: E. T. Carter
description: A field of hollow ring marks, like the punched eyelet holes of broderie-anglaise lace. A radial wave pumps each ring's radius so the eyelets breathe open and closed as the wavefront passes.

params.label: Eyelet spacing
params.effect: Distance between eyelets in CSS px - a dense ring mesh at the minimum, an open sparse field at the maximum.

params.label: Ring size
params.effect: Resting radius of the rings. Small reads as tight beads; large opens broad eyelet holes that nearly meet their neighbours.

params.label: Ring thickness
params.effect: Stroke thickness of the rings. Fine draws hairline circles; thick fattens them into bold annular marks.

params.label: Breathe
params.effect: How much a passing wavefront pumps each ring's radius. 0 is a still field; high makes the eyelets breathe open and closed.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Spacing of the concentric breathe rings; short packs many bands across the frame, long sweeps one broad wave.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the wave travels out from the source; 0 freezes the eyelets mid-breath.

params.label: Ripple count
params.effect: How many concentric breathe rings span the field. Low is one broad slow wave; high packs many tight bands.

params.label: Ring brightness
params.effect: Brightness of the rings themselves. Low keeps them subtle, high makes the eyelet lace pop in vivid colour.

params.label: Backlight
params.effect: Strength of the two soft drifting glow blobs behind the rings. 0 leaves crisp eyelets on near-black; high adds a slow colour drift.

params.label: Crispness
params.effect: Edge hardness of the rings. Low is soft glowing circles; high snaps them to crisp high-contrast eyelets.

params.label: Ripple points
params.effect: How many distinct ripple sources pump the field at once, each radiating its own concentric breathe rings.

params.label: Splash reach
params.effect: How far each ripple spreads from its source. Small keeps tight separated rings; large lets the splashes overlap.

params.label: Origin X
params.effect: Horizontal position of the point the ripples radiate from. 0 is centre; +/- drives the source toward an edge.

params.label: Origin Y
params.effect: Vertical position of the ripple source. 0 is centre; +/- pushes it up or down.
